_comment: Operator-editable shop settings. No secrets here — credentials live in ops/worker/.env (gitignored). Run `node ops.mjs` any time to see which of these still needs your attention.
shop_name_note: The exact Etsy shop name. FondlyMade was taken at registration, so the live shop is KindlyPut - every description carries this verbatim, so it must match the storefront exactly.

processing._comment: Deliberately BLANK. Etsy displays the real per-listing processing time (Printify pushes 2-5 or 3-5 days), and a description line saying otherwise contradicts the page it sits on. Our earlier "10 days" came from Printify shipping-endpoint handling_time, which is their MAXIMUM, not the commitment shown to buyers. Leaving this empty means no shipping claim is written into descriptions at all - Etsy still shows the real number. Only fill this in if it matches what Etsy displays.

min_margin_note: Net profit per unit after Printify base cost AND the fee schedule below. `node ops.mjs stage` deletes any draft that comes back under this — it will not leave a money-loser sitting in the shop.
max_products_note: Runaway guard for ONE invocation. A single stage run can never create more than this many products, no matter what the listing file says.
max_products_total_note: Runaway guard across ALL invocations. Raised 45 -> 60 for batch 3: 34 live + 12 new candles = 46.

fees._source: Confirmed by the operator against Shop Manager -> Finances -> Payment settings on 2026-07-29 (~01:55 PDT): $0.20 listing, 6.5% transaction, 3% + $0.25 processing. Offsite Ads: opted out. Shop Manager also shows a 4% Share & Save REFUND on orders from the seller's own share links — a credit, not a fee, deliberately excluded from the margin model so margins stay conservative.
fees._confirm: Confirmed 2026-07-29 by operator readback in session. Re-confirm if Etsy revises its fee schedule or the shop crosses the $10k/yr Offsite Ads mandatory threshold.
fees.offsite_ads_note: Etsy charges 12% (or 15%) only on orders that came from an Offsite Ad. Leave at 0 for a per-unit floor; raise it if you want the margin guard to survive the worst case.
fees.free_shipping_note: false = the buyer pays shipping, so it passes straight through to Printify and does not touch margin. Set true only if you offer free shipping — then the margin guard pulls the REAL first-item US shipping rate from Printify and subtracts it, and refuses to stage anything if Printify will not give it that number.
